paragraphs: Chapter 708
Episode 179. An Unavoidable Trap (7)
The temporary alliance was most concerned about the participation of the evil god before carrying out their operation.

[Of course, we cannot exclude the possibility of changes in the state of the evil god while conducting operations in Licalten. However, since it has already gone berserk once, it should take some time for it to normalize, so I don't think you need to worry too much. Unless we're going to fight in Licalten for a few days.]
If Rosa didn't directly participate in the battle, as Orgal said, the success rate of the operation could only increase dramatically.
Dephus has obtained transcendent power by receiving some authority of the evil god, but he was injured due to eternity.
Even in a complete state, no one thought that he could handle the top forces of the temporary alliance alone.
Of course, there were strong people like Fadler and Lionel and the army of chaos besides Dephus, but they seemed to be able to stand without the evil god.
The steel door began to descend slowly.

The steel door touched the sea surface and divided into two, one leading to the Huphester sea area where the prisoner rescue team including Cosmos will head, and the other leading to the center of Licalten where the Puberty will enter.
"Cosmos, get your mind right."
"Don't worry, Captain Merry. My Cosmos fleet has no history of being caught. So just take care of yourself, you haven't fully recovered from your injury yet."
"Master, I will be back."
[I can't believe I'm stuck escorting these pirate bastards...]
Balkas and Veil spoke.
Their role was to escort Cosmos' fleet until it safely landed back in Licalten from the sea, and then join the main force.
"They're not just pirates, they're vital personnel for prisoner transportation. Protect them so that not a single ship is destroyed until our allies open the way to Licalten port."
[Tsk, I got it.]
"And join us safely. You too, Veil, and Balkas."
The Puberty turned the bow to the right.
For a while, farewells were exchanged, and the ships each moved forward towards the door they would enter.
4:15 in the morning, the northern border of Licalten.
About an hour passed after the temporary alliance's operation officially started.
Zifl's fleet was successfully entering through the air defense network.
Although it could not show its full power due to Lam at the time of the total offensive, Zifl's fleet was the greatest force in humanity in name and reality.
The chaotic dragons and black lines rushing in without rest were just like moths to a flame, being oxidized into ashes.
To penetrate the fleet's defense shield, a transcendent powerhouse like Fadler was needed.
"Is it because of the evil god's rampage, as Orgal said? For some reason, RunKandel seems to be trying to buy time by exhausting their troops..."
Veradin said, spreading a map with magic.
There was still no major change in the desperate situation of Licalten.
"Dante Hyran, what do you think? Do you think they're buying time, or setting a trap?"
Dante turned his head to look at Veradin.
Usually, Dante would have been lost in thought for a moment at Veradin's unfamiliar appearance, but now was not the time.
"I think it's the latter. It's just a guess though."
"Me too. If things go as they are, we should reach the first prison camp discovered by Orgal and Zephirin in 30 minutes, did they already move the prisoners?"

"How about increasing the speed to confirm? Even if it's a trap, we must advance to Licalten Castle beyond the prison camp. Our mission with Zifl is to rescue the prisoners from the 1st and 2nd camps and then support the Jin and Bammel alliance."

"Well, if everything goes as planned, Jin and Tikan's forces would have slowly entered the center of Licalten. I think your suggestion is good. We are in a situation where we can't slowly examine and respond to any kind of trap. Most importantly, if it's not a trap, the 4th Squadron continues to focus on recovery, so it would be an opportunity."
As Veradin gave the order, the fleet increased its speed.
Kieaeeak, Kwaddeuk...!
The fragments of the black line crashing against the shield and the corpses of the chaos dragons blocked the view without rest.
About 10 minutes later, Zifl's fleet was able to confirm the 1st prisoner camp obscured by the wall of chaos.
The number of charging chaos dragons and black lines had noticeably reduced to a non-threatening level.
"I wonder if the ghastly appearance of the prison is the will of the evil god, or the personal preference of the 4th Squadron. I should ask when we meet."
The interior view from the air was a completely different landscape from a typical camp.
First of all, there was a huge tree like a castle in the center inside the wall.
The tree was full of translucent black fruits, and about fifty prisoners seemed to be trapped in each fruit.
Monsters in the shape of giants were seen picking the fruits one by one, but they did not react at all even when they saw the fleet.
The only ones who reacted fiercely to the fleet were the prisoners in the fruits.
Their voices couldn't be heard, but as soon as the prisoners saw the fleet, they desperately pounded and scratched the inside of the fruit.
Because of the blood that flowed, the fruit quickly became red.
Veradin looked down at the scene without much emotion, while Dante was shaking his fist.
Most of them were prisoners of the Empire.
"Hmm, it's strange indeed. The despair of Licalten is intensifying as soon as we arrive, Dante Hyran."
It should have been the opposite.
The feeling that those trapped in the fruit would have when they see Zifl's fleet would be, 'we're saved'.
However, the despair marked on the map kept deepening, and Dante, suppressing his boiling rage, looked at the ground again.
When he intensified his senses, he seemed to hear the voices of the people trapped in the fruit little by little.
Don't come. Don't come!
It was too faint to be sure if the prisoners were really saying that, but their gestures were clear.
The prisoners were not only pounding and scratching the fruit, but also frantically waving their hands as if to say go back.
'...Ah, I see why the despair is deepening. The 4th Squadron had told the prisoners here in advance that we would fall into a trap even if we came. Or they brainwashed them.'
It was the latter.
The prophet had manipulated the minds of the prisoners in the 1st camp, planting the perception that 'it's useless' even if the temporary alliance rescue team comes here.
The temporary alliance will fall into a trap as soon as they come here and will die in front of you.
That's the kind of perception.
"Soga! There's a magical reaction! Magic is spreading from the prison camp!"
A mage shouted.
If it was a trap, they would naturally expect the energy of chaos or an army to overwhelm the fleet, but magic was spreading around the fleet out of nowhere.
"Maximize the shield deployment."
Fortunately, the speed of the fleet strengthening the shield was faster than the magic spreading from the camp turning into magic.
'A net?'
The magic that sprang up from the camp became a huge net that could cover the entire fleet, but it was not threatening in itself.
The net attached to the shield did not have strong enough suppression to restrict the movement of the fleet.
"A storm of chaotic energy is coming!"
"The shield can handle it."
Following the reports of the onboard mages, a storm of chaotic energy struck the fleet.
The fleet did sway slightly, but neither the magic net nor the chaotic energy storm were powerful enough to penetrate the shield.
'What do this magic and ambiguous chaos energy mean?'
As the concentration of despair in the map was intensifying without a break, Veradin soon raised his head as if he had realized something.
"Captain, we can definitely break through. Please give us the order."
"No, have the whole fleet stand by! It's an illusion spell."
"An illusion spell?"
Dante asked Veradin.

"Yes. I didn't expect to see the lost illusion magic of the dark realm here. Listen everyone! To the eyes of the prisoners, we will appear to be utterly annihilated. That's exactly why the despair index is rising even though we're fine."
He was right.
Right now, the prisoners were witnessing an 'illusion' where everything was going according to the prophet's plan.
In their eyes, the entire fleet had already exploded and was falling.
"So, should we break through the remaining chaotic energy and show them that we are fine? Master Veradin."

"It's not that simple, Dante. We cannot break the illusion that controls the prisoners' minds in that way. Even if we rescue all of them and tell them they're fine, the prisoners would continue to be trapped in the illusion. The despair will continue to grow, right?"
"...What should we do?"
"Instead of disrupting the magic with a greater power, we need to break the spell. The net that covers the fleet... this means that our mages have to untangle it one by one."
"Is that the only way? I don't know much about magic, but it seems like that would take a lot of time."

"You're right, it will take at least three hours. If you want to cut down on time, you can just kill all the prisoners. The dead prisoners will be freed from the illusion, so the despair won't grow anymore."
"That's unacceptable."

"I thought you might say that. But here's the thing, this is a trap that we've foreseen all along. The intent is quite clear too. It's to buy time. To delay our entry. Probably because of the 4th Squadron leader's injury. We haven't received any information that he's recovered until the start of the operation."
"So it's a choice between rescuing the prisoners and playing into the 4th Squadron's plans... or sacrificing the prisoners and reaching the 4th Squadron a few hours earlier?"
"That's right. That's why I initially said to stop, but I'm actually torn. It might be better to kill the prisoners and move on to remove Defus."
"I said it's unacceptable to kill the prisoners with our own hands."
"So, come up with some justification. A reason why we should knowingly fall into Defus's trap."
Dante glared at Veradin.
Soon, Dante regained his composure and responded.
"I am an individual, a guardian of the empire, and a descendant of the Sword Emperor. It's embarrassing to say this myself, but I am a very special being."
"I think I know where you're going with this. I'm a little intrigued, so go on."

"After Jin first speculated why the calamity used Joshua, Orgal said that the despair of a special being would strongly influence the completion of the calamity. Therefore, my despair could be the same. So if we kill the prisoners and move on as we are, my despair will grow too much."
Veradin blinked at Dante a few times before responding.
"Alright, I'll accept that. It makes sense. All fleet mages will now prepare to break the spell quickly. All unit leaders and top mages are to gather on the flagship. I'll show you how it's done."
